priority_rubric: Composite priority score = (ICP_Fit*0.45)+(ARR_score*0.25)+(Engagement_risk_score*0.2)+(Deployment_penalty*0.1). ARR_score buckets: >250k=10,100-250k=7,25-100k=4,<25k=1. Engagement_risk_score: Low=10,Med=5,High=1. Deployment_penalty: Private/on-prem=0, Dedicated=1, Hosted=2 (higher penalty = more attention needed for cost/routing).
quick_actions:
1) High composite score & Renewal <12mo => Book executive QBR + AM-led renewal plan within 2 weeks.
2) Mid score & Engagement Risk High => Technical deep-dive + enablement sprint, assign Solutions Eng.
3) Low score & SMB => Automated renewal sequence + product-led adoption play.
4) Private/on-prem customers => Confirm KMS/HSM expirations and compliance review during QBR.
5) Dedicated customers with ARR >100k => Offer reserved capacity optimization review.
notes_to_manager: This sheet merges ICP-fit with deployment and regional weighting to surface accounts that need proactive renewal engineering. Still rough: need to validate ARR buckets and regional weighting with finance. Recommend we pilot with Renewals team for next 6 weeks and collect outcomes for rubric calibration.
